title: Dev flow v2 implementer payload
$comment: This schema describes the SHAPE of `payload` for role: implementer — see result.envelope.schema.json for how the two compose. It retains every Foreman v1 flat result.json field and type (schema:1) and adds only optional synthesis_of for Dev flow v2 council artifacts — see ponderousdev/foreman src/foreman/prompts/implementer-preamble.md and src/foreman/backend.py:read_result() at v2.5.0. `status` itself is NOT repeated in this payload: it lives once, on the envelope. The v1-documented conditional requirements (summary/handoff/ac_test_map required iff status is completed; blocked_question iff blocked) therefore cannot be expressed as a structural keyword in THIS file, because the deciding field (envelope.status) is not part of the instance this schema validates — scripts/validate-result-schemas.mjs enforces them as a receipt-validation semantic check instead, reading both the envelope and the payload together. See ai/schemas/README.md 'Composition' and 'Why implementer's conditional fields are a semantic check, not if/then'.

summary.description: Required (non-empty) when the envelope's status is completed; ignored when blocked. No minLength here: Foreman v1 serializes this as "" (empty string, not absent) on a blocked result, so the schema must accept that shape. Enforced by the validator, not by this schema — checkImplementerStatus rejects an empty string on a completed result exactly as it would a missing one.

handoff.description: Required (non-empty) when the envelope's status is completed; ignored when blocked. No minLength here: Foreman v1 serializes this as "" (empty string, not absent) on a blocked result, so the schema must accept that shape. Enforced by the validator, not by this schema — checkImplementerStatus rejects an empty string on a completed result exactly as it would a missing one.

ac_test_map.description: Required (non-empty) when the envelope's status is completed; ignored when blocked. Each entry's own shape (criterion + a non-empty tests[]) is enforced structurally regardless of status, since v1 never permitted a malformed entry either way — only the requiredness of the whole array is status-conditional.

human_tasks.description: Optional at every status, exactly as in v1: Foreman's read_result() does data.get('human_tasks', []), so a v1 blocked result in particular can carry only schema/status/blocked_question with no human_tasks key at all. When present, still constrained to an array of strings.

blocked_question.description: Required (non-null) when blocked; ignored when completed. Enforced by the validator, not by this schema.

proposed_pr_title.description: Optional at every status, exactly as in v1.

synthesis_of.description: Ordered source-proposal identities. Present only on the fresh implementer artifact produced when council strategy enables synthesis; optional so ordinary and pre-v2 implementer results remain valid.
